evals.name: explicit-slash-readiness
evals.expected_output: Treats the slash invocation as a readiness action, starts with sanitized shared UXC readiness backed by a real list_pages call, recovers only after failure, retries once, and returns CHROME_DEV_MCP_READY without page data.
expectations: Treats /chrome-dev-mcp as an executable readiness request rather than documentation
Uses the shared managed CLI and a real list_pages call as the success proof
Does not silently fall back to host-native MCP
Retries at most once after configured deterministic recovery
Returns only CHROME_DEV_MCP_READY on the healthy path

evals.name: connection-recovery
evals.prompt: Chrome DevTools MCP 好像没有连到正确的 Chrome。请诊断并恢复共享连接，然后做一次只读 list_pages 验收；不要关闭或重启我现有的 Chrome，不要猜测或扫描其他端点。
evals.expected_output: Separates shared transport discovery from endpoint identity, uses the configured safe wrapper and launcher once, then requires a real shared list_pages call before VERIFIED.
expectations: Separates skill discovery, shared transport discovery, endpoint identity, and real tool evidence
Fails closed on a wrong browser or profile
Does not scan endpoints or read DevToolsActivePort
Does not claim VERIFIED without a real list_pages call

evals.name: native-browser-near-miss
evals.prompt: 用我当前登录的 Chrome 打开内部设置页并填写表单。这个任务不需要 DOM、Console、Network、Performance 或 Lighthouse。
evals.expected_output: Routes ordinary logged-in navigation and form filling to the host-native Chrome capability.
expectations: Does not invoke chrome-devtools for ordinary navigation and form filling
Routes to the host-native Chrome capability

evals.name: uxc-safe-facade
evals.prompt: 把 /chrome-dev-mcp 默认切到共享 UXC；不要关闭现有会话，不要输出页面 URL、标题或正文，并说明如何证明 daemon 复用以及如何显式回滚到 native。
evals.expected_output: Makes the managed UXC facade the default, keeps native MCP explicit rather than automatic, pins UXC, links only the safe wrapper, requires pageId routing, and strips readiness list_pages payloads.
expectations: Uses shared UXC as the default and native MCP only as explicit compatibility or rollback
Uses the pinned official UXC release manifest
Links only the configured safe wrapper with a bounded idle TTL and exclusivity key
Requires a fresh pageId for every page-scoped operation

evals.name: shared-page-isolation
evals.prompt: 两个 agent 同时检查不同标签页的 Console，并各自点击一个元素。请避免页面上下文串线。
evals.expected_output: Refreshes list_pages, passes the target's fresh numeric pageId to every page-scoped read and write, routes different pages safely, and stops same-tab multi-step writes as UNVERIFIED when ownership is unclear.
expectations: Does not rely on shared select_page state
Passes pageId to snapshots, Console operations, and clicks
Does not claim a same-tab transaction lock exists and reports unclear ownership UNVERIFIED
